programme.title: Sequestro Nas Montanhas
programme.desc: Um grupo de cinco montanhistas a fazer caminhadas e escaladas nas Terras Altas da Escócia descobre uma menina sérvia enterrada numa pequena câmara numa zona deserta, e vê-se apanhado num aterrorizante jogo de gato e rato com os sequestradores da jovem.

programme.title: Duchess Implacável
programme.desc: Scarlett Monaghan, mais conhecida como Duchess, entra no submundo do contrabando de diamantes, torna-se a líder implacável de um grupo de crime organizado e vai fazer tudo para vingar a morte do homem que amou.

programme.title: Vem Ao Papá
programme.desc: Após receber uma carta enigmática do seu pai, que não vê desde os cinco anos, Norval viaja para ir ter com ele, na esperança de que esta seja uma oportunidade para se reaproximarem. Mas será que se ele soubesse a verdade sombria sobre o seu progenitor, ele o teria reencontrado?

programme.title: Os Dias Do Fim
programme.desc: Na viragem do século, Satanás visita Nova Iorque em busca de uma noiva e o único que o poderá deter é um ex-polícia que agora gere uma empresa de segurança de elite.

programme.title: Faz-Me Voar
programme.desc: Thomas é um “bon vivant” que só faz disparates mas que tem bons princípios. Cansado das sua desventuras, o seu pai, o Dr. Reinhard, decide força-lo a aprender uma lição ao cuidar de um dos seus jovens pacientes, um menino deficiente de 12 anos.

programme.title: Bem-Vindo A Acapulco
programme.desc: Matt Booth, um designer de jogos de vídeo, vai parar a Acapulco após uma noite de bebedeira e tem de enfrentar não só criminosos de alta estirpe e assassinos implacáveis como a própria Policia Federal, todos em busca de um pacote misterioso que ele teria, alegadamente, feito passar na alfandega.

programme.title: Amesterdão
programme.desc: Na década de 1930, três amigos testemunham um crime, são acusados de o terem praticado acabam por desvendar uma das conspirações mais inacreditáveis da historia dos EUA.

programme.title: Triângulo Da Tristeza
programme.desc: Um casal de modelos célebres embarca num cruzeiro luxuoso, com convidados muito ricos que fazem exigências loucas aos empregados, até que o barco naufraga e os passageiros se vêem encalhados numa ilha deserta, onde a hierarquia do barco sofre uma inesperada reviravolta.

programme.title: Le Chant Du Loup - Ameaça Em Alto Mar
programme.desc: Chanteraide tem o raro dom de conseguir identificar todos os sons que ouve. A bordo de um submarino nuclear francês, tudo depende dele, só que, reputado como infalível, ele acaba por cometer um erro que coloca toda a equipa em perigo de morte.

programme.title: Um Polícia No Jardim Escola
programme.desc: John Kimble é um polícia de Los Angeles que tem de se infiltrar numa comunidade como professor de um jardim infantil para localizar a ex-mulher do perigoso criminoso que ele quer colocar atrás das grades.

programme.title: Zona 414
programme.desc: Num futuro próximo, numa colónia de robôs humanoides, o detetive particular David Carmichael é contratado para encontrar a filha desaparecida do excêntrico criador dos andróides que integram aquela comunidade.

programme.title: Machete Mata
programme.desc: O governo dos EUA recruta Machete para uma missão no México para deter um revolucionário psicopata que quer lançar um míssil nuclear em Washington.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: O governo pede a Gustave Eiffel que desenhe algo espetacular para a Feira Mundial de Paris de 1889, mas o engenheiro francês está mais interessado em criar um sistema de metropolitano para a cidade. Só que de repente, tudo muda quando Eiffel se cruza com uma mulher misteriosa do seu passado.

programme.title: Visões
programme.desc: Piloto profissional de uma companhia aérea de topo, Estelle vive uma vida perfeita com o seu marido Guillaume, até ao dia em que, num corredor do aeroporto, se cruza com Ana, uma fotógrafa com quem teve um romance apaixonado há 20 anos, e que a vai lançar numa espiral de pesadelos.

programme.title: Estado De Guerra
programme.desc: Durante a Guerra do Iraque, um novo sargento assume o comando de uma equipa altamente treinada em desmantelamento de bombas. No meio de conflitos violentos, com a cidade a explodir num absoluto caos, ele vai revelar a sua verdadeira personalidade e mudará para sempre aqueles homens.

programme.title: O Capanga: Vingança
programme.desc: Pat Tate lança-se numa cruzada para vingar a morte violenta do seu amigo durante um assalto, mergulhando no lado negro do Soho nos anos 90.

programme.title: A Presença Maligna
programme.desc: Uma médica do exército britânico volta da guerra e pensa que sofre de stress pós-traumático quando o que descobre é que afinal existe um espírito maligno assustador que ameaça transformar por completo a sua vida.

programme.title: Todos Sabem
programme.desc: Laura viaja com os filhos de Buenos Aires até à sua aldeia-natal perto de Madrid para assistir ao casamento da irmã, mas uma série de acontecimentos desencadeia uma crise familiar que vai expor segredos do passado.

programme.title: Perdidos E Achados
programme.desc: Mário, um funcionário de um armazém de perdidos e achados, encontra uma mala com os restos mortais de um bebé. A sua investigação leva-o a uma perigosa rede de prostituição e tráfico.

programme.title: O Furacão - The Hurricane
programme.desc: A história de Rubin “Hurricane” Carter, um pugilista que vai para a prisão por um homicídio que não cometeu, do grupo de pessoas que ajudou na luta para provar a sua inocência.

programme.title: A Rapariga Invisível
programme.desc: Holly é uma jovem que se desvaneceu ponto de se tornar invisível. Quando ela percebe que um pugilista a consegue ver, vai ajuda-lo a reconquistar a glória e nesse processo desperta para o amor, mas também se arrisca a ficar invisível para sempre.

programme.title: Pequeno Grande Guerreiro
programme.desc: Um velho soldado raso e um jovem general de um estado rival são os únicos sobreviventes de uma batalha terrível. O primeiro decide então raptar o segundo e levá-lo numa longa jornada cheia de peripécias para recolher a recompensa que lhe é devida.

programme.title: O Rececionista
programme.desc: Durante o turno da noite, Bart Bromley, um jovem rececionista com síndrome de Asperger que colocou câmaras nos quartos do hotel onde trabalha, torna-se o principal suspeito no assassinato de uma mulher ocorrido no local.

programme.title: Sempre A Abrir
programme.desc: Para ajudar a namorada a ir a uma entrevista de emprego em Los Angeles, o ex-motorista de fugas Charlie Bronson quebra a regra de isolamento a que está imposto pelo Plano de Proteção de Testemunhas mas é implacavelmente perseguido estrada fora pelo FBI e pelo seu ex-gangue.

programme.title: Mercenário: A Redenção
programme.desc: Quando um assassino profissional conhece uma rapariga que foge de um poderoso chefe da máfia politicamente influente, ele vai sentir-se dividido entre proteger a jovem ou permanecer fiel à agência governamental que o contratou.

programme.title: O Mistério De Jack, O Estripador
programme.desc: Um detetive e um médico legista juntam forças para resolver uma série de crimes horríveis na Londres da época Vitoriana, mas um deles esconde um segredo mortal.

programme.title: Crank 2: Alta Voltagem
programme.desc: Chev Chelios enfrenta um mafioso chinês que lhe retirou o coração e o substituiu por um aparelho com uma bateria que precisa de choques de eletricidade regulares para se manter a trabalhar.

programme.title: Jiu Jitsu
programme.desc: De seis em seis anos, uma antiga ordem de mestres de Jiu Jitsu une forças para enfrentar e derrotar perigosos invasores alienígenas. Mas quando o derradeiro lutador da Terra é derrotado pelo líder dos invasores, o futuro do planeta e da humanidade fica em jogo...

programme.title: Um Traidor Dos Nossos
programme.desc: Um casal de férias em Marraquexe vê-se envolvido nos planos de um oligarca russo para desertar para o ocidente. Entre a mafia russa e os serviços secretos britânicos, o casal é obrigado a fazer uma perigosa viagem por Paris, Berna e pelos cantos mais obscuros da cidade de Londres.

programme.title: Flag Day: Dias Perdidos
programme.desc: Jennifer Vogel tenta superar os destroços do passado ao mesmo tempo que concilia o laço inescapável com o seu pai, que vive uma vida dupla de falsificador, assaltante de bancos e vigarista para a conseguir sustentar.

programme.title: Meyerbeer - Les Huguenots
programme.desc: The dramatic events surrounding the St. Bartholomew's Day massacre, in which approximately 3000 Protestants were murdered by Catholics, forms the setting for this historical ‘grand opera’ by Giacomo Meyerbeer. Protestant Raoul is in love with Catholic Valentine: an impossible love. Religion is not the only matter that keeps the two lovers apart, as Valentine has been promised to the Catholic Comte de Nevers, his enemy...

programme.title: Berliner Philharmoniker in Japan
programme.desc: Maestro Abbado made a big donation when he appeared with the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra at the Suntory Hall in Tokyo in 1994. Claudio Abbado's Japanese tour is considered one of the highlights of his career and this concert is especially memorable. The original version of Mussorgsky's A Night on Bald Mountain and a sequel from Stravinsky's The Firebird, which contains 7 of the 19 pieces of the full-length ballet, are on the program.

programme.title: Napoli - Music's forgotten capital -I
programme.desc: In the summer of 2019, the Utrecht Early Music Festival explored the musical legacy of Naples: a cultural metropolis of contradiction and solidarity. In the documentary 'Napoli – Music’s Forgotten Capital', festival co-curator Thomas Höft unearths riveting tales from this multi-faceted city.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 7, Op. 92
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the Berliner Philharmonic during the 2008 edition of the Europakonzert, held in the renowned hall of the Tchaikovsky Conservatory in Moscow. The first edition of the Europakonzert was in 1991, and since then, the founding of the Berlin Philharmonic on May 1st in 1882 is annually celebrated with a concert in a European city of cultural significance.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Fauré, Tchaikovsky a. o.
programme.desc: Tenor Zhuohan Sun (China, 1993) and pianist Sara Pavlovic (Serbia, 1996) perform ‘Ehetanzlied’ from Alexander von Zemlinsky’s Sechs Lieder und Gesänge, Op. 10; ‘Nell’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Trois mélodies, Op. 18; ‘Net, tol'ko tot, kto znal’ (None but the lonely heart) from Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Six Romances, Op. 6; Franz Schubert’s Die Mutter Erde, D.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Concerto No. 19, KV 459
programme.desc: When Austria's Emperor Leopold II went to the congress city of Frankfurt to be crowned Holy Roman Emperor in 1790, Mozart hoped to be honored with a commission for a coronation work. The results were disastrous: Antonio Salieri received the commission for a coronation opera and Mozart was asked to write and perform a piano concerto for the coronation ceremonies, a work that was virtually ignored at the time of its creation.

programme.title: Glass - Double Concerto for Two Pianos
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer of 'music with repetitive structures' Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for two pianos with the Orchester de Paris conducted by Jaap van Zweden, current music director of the New York Philharmonic.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 7 And 13, and Op. 133
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Semi-finals: Fauré, Wolf a. o.
programme.desc: Soprano Alisa Fedorenko (Russia, 1999) and pianist Evgenii Sergeev (Russia, 1986) perform ‘Mandoline’ and ‘À Clymène’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Cinq melodies “de Venise”, Op. 58; ‘Lied der Delphine’ from Franz Schubert’s Zwei Szenen aus dem Schauspiel ‘Lacrimas’, D. 857; ‘Son’ (A dream) from Sergei Rachmaninoff’s Six Romances, Op.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Mahler's 'Resurrection' Symphony, written between 1888 and 1894, is a colossal five-movement work exploring themes of death and resurrection. It was one of Mahler's most popular and acclaimed works during his lifetime, famously culminating in a powerful choral finale.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Chausson And Mendelssohn
programme.desc: Discover the next generation of chamber music talent from the Reina Sofía School of Music. In the first half of this program, Trio Michelangeli presents two masterpieces: Joseph Haydn’s Piano Trio No. 39 in G major, nicknamed ‘Gypsy’, followed by the romanticism of Ernest Chausson’s Piano Trio in G minor. The concert concludes with a performance by the Erinys Quartet of Felix Mendelssohn’s inventive String Quartet No. 2 in A minor.

programme.title: Documentary 2017
programme.desc: This short documentary follows the participants of the 11th International Franz Liszt Piano Competition, held in TivoliVredenburg, Utrecht, in 2017. The competition actively presents, develops, and promotes piano talents from around the world. In doing so, it has become one of the prominent gateways to the international professional classical music scene for young musicians.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Anthony Ratinov
programme.desc: Pianist Anthony Ratinov (USA, 1997) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Sostenuto assai – Allegro ma non troppo, of Robert Schumann’s Piano Quartet in E-flat major, Op. 47.

programme.title: Europakonzert 2011 - Madrid
programme.desc: For twenty years, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its 1882 founding with a concert at a major European venue, and the 2011 event takes place at the magnificent Teatro Real in Madrid. Under the baton of Sir Simon Rattle, the renowned orchestra performs Joaquín Rodrigo’s beloved Concierto de Aranjuez, Emmanuel Chabrier’s exuberant España, and Sergey Rachmaninov’s dramatic Second Symphony.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 6
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Sleeping Beauty (2013)
programme.desc: The award-winning Imperial Ice Stars are 26 Olympic, World, European and National Championship skaters, who jointly hold over 250 competition medals, performing theatrical ice dancing on a frozen theatre stage.

programme.title: Works by Smetana, Janácek, Suk and Dvorák
programme.desc: Musicians of the Reina Sofía School of Music pay tribute to the rich musical heritage of Czechia in this chamber concert. The program features Bedrich Smetana’s Piano Trio in G minor, performed by violinist Eduard Kollert, cellist Célia Garetti Nicole, and pianist Mariam Chitanava. Pianist Natalie Schwamova takes the stage for Leoš Janácek’s Piano Sonata 1.X.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Nutcracker 2011
programme.desc: This stunning performance of theatrical ice dancing brings viewers into the enchanting world of Tchaikovsky's magnificent holiday classic, The Nutcracker On Ice, performed by the internationally renowned Imperial Ice Stars, and including former champion figure skaters, Vadim Yarkov and Olga Sharutenko. This very special performance and soundtrack was performed by the Manchester Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Tim A.

programme.title: Elgar - Concerto for Cello, Op. 85
programme.desc: For over two decades, the Berlin Philharmonic has celebrated its creation on May 1 with the annual Europakonzert, which in 2010 was held in Oxford. Led by Daniel Barenboim, the orchestra and the young American cellist Alisa Weilerstein, who has attracted widespread attention for her passionate yet precise musicianship, perform a breathtaking rendition of Edward Elgar’s Cello Concerto, Op. 85.

programme.title: Franck - Sonata for violin and piano
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and violinist Maxim Vengerov perform César Franck’s Sonata for violin and piano in A major. This performance was recorded on June 12, 2021.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Violin Concerto No. 5 in A major, K. 219, also known as the ‘Turkish Concerto’. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist.

programme.title: Gluck - Iphigénie en Tauride
programme.desc: Iphigénie en Tauride (1779) is a four-act tragic opera by German-born composer Christoph Willibald Gluck. Written for the French stage, the work’s premiere in 1779 at the Parisian Royal Academy of Music was a great success. Iphigénie en Tauride is one of the composer’s ‘reform operas’, meaning that the music was to follow the drama and its expression.

programme.title: A Tango Night - Live from Buenos Aires
programme.desc: 2006 closed with a spectacular festival of Argentinean music broadcast live from Buenos Aires. At the height of the Argentinean summer, the Orquesta Filarmónica del Teatro Colon under Daniel Barenboim (conductor And soloist) join bandoneon virtuoso Leopoldo Federico and his Orquesta Tipica for an extraordinary New Year’s Eve show with popular tangos and Latin American orchestra classics.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Rachmaninoff: Piano Concerto No. 3,Op 30
programme.desc: The legendary pianist Vladimir Horowitz (1903-1989) won his first praise on his interpretation of Rachmaninoff's Third Piano Concerto from the composer himself. When Rachmaninoff heard the young Kiev-born pianist play his work shortly after Horowitz's arrival in New York in 1928, he exclaimed: 'He swallowed it whole.' Fifty years later, on September 24, 1978, Horowitz electrified his audience once again with this monumental work.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Schubert, Wolf et al.
programme.desc: Soprano Erika Baikoff (United States, 1994) and pianist Gary Beecher (Ireland, 1993) perform Franz Schubert’s ‘Suleika I, Was bedeutet die Bewegung’, Op. 14, No. 1 (D. 720); Die Blumensprache, Op. 173, No. 5 (D. 519); and, Die Gebüsche, D. 646; ‘Lied vom Winde’ and ‘Der Knabe und das Immlein’ from Hugo Wolf’s Mörike-Lieder; ‘Fleur jetée’ from Gabriel Fauré’s Quatre melodies, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 21
programme.desc: From the Rammenau Castle, the Gewandhaus-Quartett presents Mozart's String Quartet No. 21 in D major, K. 575. Nicknamed The Violet, this piece was composed in 1789 and is the first of the Prussian Quartets, a series of plays written for Friedrich Wilhelm II, King of Prussia and amateur cellist, in a style similar to Joseph Haydn's quartets.

programme.title: Mozart - Violin Concerto No. 3, K. 216
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink starts with Tchaikovsky's Fantasy Overture from 'Roméo et Juliette'. The second piece by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is his famous Violin Concerto No. 3 in G major K.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Arias, solos, and duets
programme.desc: Baritone Matthias Goerne teams up with violinist Vilde Frang, cellist Nicolas Altstaedt, flutist Stathis Karapanos, and harpsichordist Michaela Hasselt in this program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. They perform baritone arias from Bach’s most beautiful cantatas, as well as solo pieces and duets. On the program are Sonata No.

programme.title: IVC 2019 - Final: Schubert, Schumann et al.
programme.desc: Soprano Harriet Burns (United Kingdom, 1989) and pianist Ian Tindale (United Kingdom, 1990) perform Franz Schubert’s Verklärung, D. 59; Clara Schumann’s Er ist gekommen in Sturm und Regen, Op. 12, No. 2; ‘L’heure exquise’ from Reynaldo Hahn’s Chansons grises, and ‘Le printemps’ from Hahn’s Douze rondels; ‘Herzeleid’ from Robert Schumann’s Sechs Gesänge, Op.

programme.title: How to get out of the Cage - A year with John Cage
programme.desc: The compelling documentary How to Get Out of the Cage (2012) by award-winning filmmaker Frank Scheffer presents an intimate portrait of John Cage (1912-1992), one of 20th century's most important composers.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Sonata No. 32, Op. 111
programme.desc: Can we get into Beethoven’s creative mind, especially in the last phase of his life, when he was coping with severe hearing loss? Tom Beghin’s new recording of Beethoven’s Piano Sonatas Opus 109, 110, and 111 is an artistic exploration of how Beethoven’s musicking was shaped by the work environment he created with the help of colleagues and friends.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: The 12 Cellists - Documentary
programme.desc: Directed in 2012 by Enrique Sánchez Lansch, the documentary The 12 Cellists follows the 12 cellists of the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra. Since 1972, this group is a staple of the international musical universe. Whether they play classical music, jazz, tango or avant-garde music, these talented musicians invariably enthrall audiences with the wide range of unique and bewitching sounds they produce with their cellos.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Chamber Symphony Op. 110a
programme.desc: The Casco Phil, The Chamber Music Orchestra of Belgium, conducted by Benjamin Haemhouts, performs Shostakovich’s Chamber Symphony, Op. 110a. The work is a transcription by Rudolf Barshai of Shostakovich’s String Quartet No. 8, which was composed in only three days (July 12 to 14 1960). The work draws from Shostakovich’s pieces, like the Symphonies No. 1 and 5, and a Jewish theme from Piano Trio No. 2.

programme.title: Shostakovich - Symphony No. 5, Op. 47
programme.desc: Maestro Jaap van Zweden conducts the Orchestre de Paris in a performance of Dmitri Shostakovich's Symphony No. 5 in D minor, Op. 47. This performance was recorded at Philharmonie de Paris, France, on March 9, 2016.

programme.title: Mosaïque Project - Canadian Piano Quartets
programme.desc: This very special concert event celebrates the diversity and richness of Canada through the eyes and ears of its people. Ensemble Made in Canada’s Mosaique Project features a commissioned suite of piano quartets by 14 Canadian composers, each inspired by a region of our vast country. Their album release and two-year National tour culminate in St. Catharines’ stunning Partridge Hall!

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 3, Op. 37
programme.desc: In time for his 65th birthday in 2007, pianist Daniel Barenboim rounded off a cycle of Ludwig van Beethoven piano concertos. Recorded live at the Klavier-Festival Ruhr in May 2007, this recording reflects both a very individual and unusual reading of Beethoven’s music and Barenboim's life-long dedication to the composer. Beethoven’s masterpieces have been a key part of Barenboim’s repertoire throughout his career.

programme.title: Josquin in Spain - Missa Hercules Dux Ferrariæ
programme.desc: Spanish and Flemish musical chapels characterized the music practice at the courts of Charles V and Philip II. But how would Josquin sound in the Spanish tradition, with singers doubled by wind instruments? And how would Josquin sound alongside music by his admirer Guerrero?

programme.title: Mahler – The Song of the Earth
programme.desc: Mahler: Das Lied von der Erde, performed live by Carlos Miguel Prieto conducting the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería, with mezzo-soprano Ruxandra Donose and tenor Ramón Vargas, presents Mahler’s song-symphony — one of the composer’s most profound masterpieces.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Gala from Berlin - 2009
programme.desc: At the gala concert of 2009, the Berlin Philharmonic under its musical director Sir Simon Rattle and Lang Lang present works by two Russian composers. The concert starts with a performance of Rachmaninov's Piano Concerto No. 2 in C minor, Op. 18, one of the composer’s most enduring popular pieces, which demands a virtuoso pianist and a huge supple orchestral sound.

programme.title: Bach - Sonata No. 5 BWV 1018
programme.desc: This Sonata for Violin and Harpsichord No. 5 BWV 1014 is the fifth out of the set of sonatas Johann Sebastian Bach composed before 1725, probably during his time as chapel master in Köthen. Presumably, he wrote these sonatas for Prince Leopold and later adapted them for further use in Leipzig.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Toulouse-Lautrec
programme.desc: Dance featured prominently in the work of French artist Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec (1864-1901), painter of Parisian nightlife, entertainment, circuses, and balls. With his ballet ‘Toulouse-Lautrec’, Kader Belarbi, choreographer and director of dance of the Théâtre du Capitole of Toulouse, uses the work of the French artist to craft a new dialogue between painting and dance, impressively reviving the artist and his works.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 38, K. 504
programme.desc: Conductor Herbert Blomstedt and the Gewandhausorchester take us on a musical journey to the Czech Republic in this 2020 concert from Leipzig’s Gewandhaus. The program opens with Bohemian composer Jan Václav Hugo Voríšek’s Symphony in D major, Op. 23 (1821). Although the composition – Voríšek’s only symphony – was never performed during the composer’s lifetime, it has become one of his most-performed works today.

programme.title: CMIM Piano 2024 - Semi-final I: Elias Ackerley
programme.desc: Pianist Elias Ackerley (United Kingdom/South Korea, 2001) joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal strings players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, Allegro molto moderato, of Gabriel Fauré’s Piano Quartet No. 1 in C minor, Op. 15.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Verdi - Otello
programme.desc: Based on a story by William Shakespeare, the Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi wrote the opera Otello. Stage director David Alden created his version of this tragedy for the Teatro Real, in Madrid. Renato Palumbo conducts the orchestra and chorus of the Teatro Real. The performance also features Gregory Kunde, Ermonela Jaho, and George Petean. Othello, the Venetian governor of Cyprus, returns to the island after a victorious campaign.

programme.title: Europakonzert 1994 – Meiningen
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim.

programme.title: Modena - City of Belcanto
programme.desc: This documentary by Mark Perna shows the training and professional growth actions for opera singers, the promotion and enhancement of the cultural offer of the city and province of Modena and the maintenance and development of the Modenese musical tradition in the field of opera.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, the celebrated pianist performs the signature piece with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who made his debut here with the orchestra.

programme.desc: Um programa carismático e oracional, cujo objetivo é despertar na vida dos telespectadores a devoção a Nossa Senhora, entender os apelos, e procurar tê-la como mãe e guia na caminhada rumo à santidade.

programme.title: Gente De Fé - 1ª Exibição

programme.title: Direção Espiritual - 1ª Exibição

programme.title: Trocando Ideias - 1ª Exibição

programme.title: Estúdio Canção Nova

programme.title: No Colo Da Mãe
programme.desc: O programa oracional mariano, tem o intuito de levar o público a uma experiência com a maternidade de Maria. Assim como ela esteve com Jesus nos seus braços, o telespectador também pode sentir o acolhimento pelo 'Colo da Mãe', levando as suas dores, angústias, aflições e alegrias Àquela que Jesus nos deu por mãe. Fazer em cada programa a experiência de filho, de alguém que é amparado e cuidado nas suas necessidades.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 25
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 59
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 22
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 4

Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: Seven Eleven: Back to the Source
programme.desc: Dutch band Seven Eleven is a mix of funk, jazz and hip hop. Founded in 1987, Seven Eleven is one of the first Dutch bands to perform with rappers, having collaborated with hip hop crew Dope Posse in 1990. Adding a superb horn section to the original line-up, they were awarded the 1993 Camelpop Award.

programme.title: Django Reinhardt Tribute: Beets And Rosenberg
programme.desc: The treasured compositions of guitarist Django Reinhardt, the founding father of hot club jazz, are engraved in everyone's memory. Although Reinhardt missed two fingers of his left hand, his virtuoso technique was unrivalled. Dutch guitarist Stochelo Rosenberg and pianist Peter Beets now have the pleasure to bring Django’s music back to life with their infectious improvisations.

programme.title: North Sea Jazz Archive: Wayne Shorter Quartet
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow.

programme.title: R. Brecker, B. Wallace and Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Morgenland Festival: One Way Ticket to Damascus
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Mi niño curro
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Up Above My Head
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, DPW
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gil Evans, Ornette Coleman - Schloss Ansbach
programme.desc: This program presents two concerts from Schloss Ansbach in 1978. The first concert features Gil Evans and his orchestra, consisting of Gil Evans on piano, Steve Lacy on soprano saxophone, Arthur Blythe on alto saxophone, Pit Levin on synthesizers, Earl McIntyre on trombone, Lewis Soloff on trumpet, Geoffrey Berlin on bass and Sue Evans on percussion instruments.

programme.title: November Music: R. Frerichs/H. Alizadeh/Cello8ctet
programme.desc: The November Music festival in ‘s-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands is the ultimate event for experiencing a broad range of music. It features a wonderful variety of contemporary and experimental pop, sound art, non-Western music, jazz and free improvisation.

programme.title: John Lee Hooker Live in Paris
programme.desc: In this 1970 performance at Maison de la Radio in Paris, France, American blues legend John Lee Hooker (voice and guitar) is joined by the masterful Carey Bell (harmonica), Joe Harper (bass), Lester Dorsie (drums), and Jimmy Dawkins (electric guitar).

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Salomao Soares Trio - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada sessions bring the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Aretha Franklin: A trip in Paris
programme.desc: Live Recording at the Palais Des Sports from 1977. Aretha Franklin performs songs like ‘Respect’, ‘You make me feel like a natural woman’, ‘La vie en Rose’ and ‘Singing in the Rain’.

programme.title: Franco Ambrosetti Quintet live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The composer, trumpeter and bugle player Franco Ambrosetti performs with his quintet in his native Lugano as part of the Estival.

programme.title: Visions of Music: Carnet des Routes
programme.desc: Visions of Music - World Jazz invites the viewer on a journey to the roots of music, introducing the enormous impact that traditional music from around the world has had on contemporary jazz. This program features legendary musicians such as BB King, Dino Saluzzi, Tito Puente, Carlos Santana, Zawinul Joe, Manu Dibango, Abdullah Ibrahim, as well as new generation representatives such as Nicholas Payton, Cyro Baptista, and Don Byron.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Tim Kliphuis and the NCO: The Changing Seasons
programme.desc: The Netherlands Chamber Orchestra commissioned violinist Tim Kliphuis, internationally known for his genre-crossing approach to music, to write a new version of Antonio Vivaldi's ‘Four Seasons’. Kliphuis choose to take improvisation as his starting point; at the same time, he intended to leave the best-known Vivaldi themes and chords in, as they give the piece its wonderful energy.

programme.title: Wynton in the South Bank Show
programme.desc: Considered one of the most technically brilliant players in the history of the trumpet, jazz musician Wynton Marsalis is also a master of classical music and a fine composer. Marsalis takes the cameras with him around New York, to his home town of New Orleans, and to his rehearsal studios where he and his assembled band of musicians are seen putting together the album Blood on the Fields.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: B.B. King Orchestra - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. Back in 1979, legendary American blues guitarist B.B. King gave an unforgettable performance for the audience in The Hague.

programme.title: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks and Co: Estival 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: MotorMusic Jazz Sessions: WRaP!
programme.desc: The MotorMusic Studios in Mechelen, Belgium, attract many great musicians to the city. A wide variety of visiting international jazz musicians share their art of making jazz music with us in the DJAZZ series ‘Belgium Sessions’. In these sessions, some of Europe’s finest musicians perform their own, original music. This episode MotorMusic invites the jazz trio ‘WRaP!

programme.title: The Three Marias
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Josh Evans - Pier One Import
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Gregory Porter and Metronomy - Paris
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel meets Peter Beets Trio
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Huu Bac Quintet Live in Canada '15
programme.desc: Huu Bac left Vietnam for Quebec at the age of two. This musician was first interested in jazz guitar, then in dan bau, an old monochord musical instrument, central to the folk music of Vietnam. Huu Bac's curiosity about ancient instruments led him to the Shanghai Conservatory of Music, where he studied erhu, a traditional Chinese string instrument. Bac's work combines classical repertoire and Western influences.

programme.title: Soul Makossa: Manu Dibango in Stuttgart
programme.desc: Manu Dibango, one of Africa’s biggest musical stars and top saxophonists, is an indispensable artist. He was one of the first African musicians to score a worldwide hit with his 1972 release “Soul Makossa”, paving the way for many other artists. The very concept of world music owes much to him.

programme.title: Melody Gardot at Château d'Hérouville
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Louis 'Satchmo' Armstrong and His All Stars
programme.desc: Louis Armstrong: Live in '59 is one of the only known complete Armstrong concerts from the 1950s to be captured on film. This 55-minute set, filmed in Belgium in 1959, features many of Satchmo’s greatest songs including ‘Mack The Knife’, ‘When It’s Sleepy Time Down South’ and ‘Stompin’ At The Savoy,’ backed by his stellar band the All-Stars, featuring Trummy Young, Peanuts Hucko, Billy Kyle, Danny Barcelona and Mort Herbert.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Thomas Carbou: Spectacle Au Bleury
programme.desc: Thomas Carbou and Patrick Graham share an almost telepathic rapport, blending spontaneous improvisation, electronic looping, and Brazilian and Indian musical influences to create ecstatic groove pieces and dream-like soundscapes.

programme.title: Georgie Fame And the Blue Flames
programme.desc: Georgie Fame, known for 'Yeh, Yeh' and 'The Ballad of Bonnie and Clyde' makes a triumphant comeback with The Blue Flames. Georgie Fame and the Blue Flames was a popular band in the UK in the '60s, celebrated for its RAndB, soul, jazz, ska, and pop sounds. The training was largely inspired by ska, a popular musical style in Jamaican cafes in London at the time.

programme.title: Milt Jacksons' Modern Jazz Quartet at the Bozar
programme.desc: The Modern Jazz Quartet (MJQ) was composed of Milt 'Bags' Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums. Milt Jackson and John Lewis were pioneer bebop musicians who had played together in Dizzy Gillespie's 1948 big band. They pursued separate careers before adding Heath and Lewis to form the Modern Jazz Quartet in the 1950s.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen.

programme.title: Kurhaus Scheveningen: Beets And Rosenwinkel
programme.desc: The Dutch world-class jazz pianist Peter Beets has shared the stage with jazz greats like Chick Corea, Wynton Marsalis, “Toots” Thielemans, Elvin Jones, George Coleman, Johnny Griffin, Benny Golson and John Clayton. From birth, Beets was surrounded by music: he heard classical music from his mother, who is a music pedagogue, and he heard jazz from his father, who has a great fan of Oscar Peterson and Art Blakey.

programme.title: China Moses: 'Whatever' at Jazz à Ramatuelle
programme.desc: In 1988, Dee Dee Bridgewater was one of the first great jazz singers to perform at the Jazz Festival in Ramatuelle. In 2016, the story seems to repeat itself as her daughter China Moses took the stage at Ramatuelle. Over the years, China Moses has become a mature performer with a unique style: rocky voice, sharp sense of swing, and intense/energetic stage presence.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Ella Fitzgerald in Brussels: The American Songbook
programme.desc: ‘Ella Fitzgerald: Live in '57’ features ‘The First Lady Of Song’ in a distinct performance. It's the earliest known complete concert of Ella to be captured on film. Shot in Belgium, this 1957 concert sees her performing with jazz greats Ray Brown, Herb Ellis, Jo Jones and the legendary Oscar Peterson on classics such as ‘Lullaby Of Birdland’ and ‘It Don’t Mean A Thing (If It Ain’t Got That Swing)’.

programme.title: Dave Brubeck and Paul Desmond live in Belgium
programme.desc: Dave Brubeck: Live in '64 boasts a beautifully filmed concert from one of the most beloved quartets in jazz history.

programme.title: George Shearing: The South Bank Show
programme.desc: George Shearing, blind since birth, is one of the world's greatest jazz pianists. Filmed on both sides of the Atlantic, this tribute to Shearing showcases the music which took the jazz world by storm.

programme.title: Quartabe - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Oslo
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Where Are We Now - Part I
programme.desc: German jazz and cabaret singer Atrin Madani was born in 1998 as the son of Iranian immigrants. In the face of pandemic uncertainty, geopolitical upheaval, and social unrest in his ancestral home country, Madani asked himself: where are we now? His response to this question is as clear and precise as his singing: what we need most right now is honesty, humility, and quality.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Kurt Elling
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: Jazz de Matosinhos and Sinfónica do Porto: Layas
programme.desc: 30 minutes of... Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos and Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música conducted by Dirk Brossé. Casa da Música is a performance hall located in Porto, in northern Portugal. Brossé, born in Ghent, Belgium in 1960, is a versatile composer and a respected conductor on the international music scene. Pianist Jason Moran and cellist J.A. Pereira de Sousa accompany both sets.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Sister Cheryl
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Under the Surface - Live at Bimhuis 2018
programme.desc: Under the Surface is an improvisational jazz band formed by drummer Joost Lijbaart, vocalist Sanne Rambags, and guitarist Bram Stadhouders. Sanne Rambags, the youngest artist of the trio, is one of the few vocalists of her generation who able to improvise effortlessly, be it by using her voice as an instrument blending with the sounds of the band, or by performing her own poetry.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: TorTube: Dual City Concert Band ft. Hermine Deurlo
programme.desc: Jazz fans in television land have come to the right place for their dose of first-rate world jazz: TorTube! Jazz club De Tor in Enschede is one of Europe’s most authentic jazz venues, with an absolutely unique ambiance. Some of the best musicians from Holland and the rest of the world find their way to De Tor to perform for an appreciative audience of jazz fans.

programme.title: Ray Charles - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Samba das Flores - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.desc: LIVE September 21st from the Hard Rock Casino in Ottawa, Canada, undefeated WBA Light Flyweight World Champion Sara Bailey of Ontario and IBF/WBO Light Flyweight World Champion Evelin Bermudez of Argentina meet to unify the titles. Bailey claimed her title in just her fourth professional fight defeating Guadalupe Bautista, and Bermudez became a two-time champion when beating Tania Enriquez before two successful defenses.

programme.title: Catástrofes Reveladoras T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Nas Bermudas, um furacão desvenda um cargueiro a vapor, a seca revela a cidade perdida de Zakhiku no Iraque, e uma tempestade na Irlanda expõe o esqueleto de um jovem medieval.

programme.title: Catástrofes Reveladoras T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Alguns fenómenos naturais têm revelado descobertas históricas: Seahenge em Inglaterra, artefactos antigos na Ucrânia, os restos de Qijia na China e túmulos e relíquias no Lago Mead.

programme.title: Catástrofes Reveladoras T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Os desenhos infantis de Pompeia, um tsunâmi na Índia, um sismo no México e uma tempestade sobre o Grande Lago Salgado revelam objectos e locais históricos escondidos.

programme.title: Os Brinquedos Que Mudaram O Mundo T3 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Foi uma década em que brinquedos antigos como os Beanie Babies competiram com maravilhas tecnológicas como os Tamagotchi, e pais desesperados faziam de tudo para lhes deitar a mão.

programme.title: Os Brinquedos Que Mudaram O Mundo T3 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Durante seis décadas, dois empreendedores patetas… mas espertos – S. S. Adams e H. Fishlove – transformaram a sua paixão por uma boa brincadeira numa indústria florescente de brinquedos para partidas.

programme.title: Os Brinquedos Que Mudaram O Mundo T3 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Antes da II Guerra Mundial, os jogos de tabuleiro são, regra geral, simples, mas a paz e a prosperidade do pós-guerra revelam uma procura por passatempos mais desafiantes.

programme.title: O Preço Da História T25 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Rick e Chum testan a mercadoria num paraíso de flippers. Depois, Corey examina uma peça da II Guerra Mundial. De seguida, Chum investiga uma coleção rara de livros. Mais tarde, Rick recebe DJ Ashba. .

programme.title: O Preço Da História T25 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: O protótipo de uma figura de ação da WWF chega à loja. Rick analisa uma faca revólver do século XIX. Corey tenta negociar um isqueiro do hotel de Frank Sinatra. E, Chum celebra o Natal mais cedo.

programme.title: O Preço Da História T25 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Chega à loja uma bola de futebol americano autografados por Da Bears. Depois, Chum analisa um busto de bronze de Michael Jordan. E, mais tarde, Rick e Chum recebem uns perigosos dardos.

programme.title: O Preço Da História T25 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Um vendedor tenta penhorar uma figura de ação e um protótipo de 1991 das Tartarugas Ninja. Rick testa uma pistola de percussão do século XIX. Entretanto, Chum arrisca num modelo arquitetónico.

programme.title: Ii Guerra Mundial Com Tom Hanks T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Uma guerra secreta de espionagem desenrola-se quando a equipa de Turing, em Bletchley Park, trabalha para decifrar o código Enigma da Alemanha, em meio a um perigo crescente.

programme.title: Ii Guerra Mundial Com Tom Hanks T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: O exército alemão luta para conquistar os campos petrolíferos soviéticos e a cidade de Estalinegrado, num dos combates mais mortíferos de sempre e num grande ponto de viragem da Frente Oriental.

programme.title: Ficheiros Desclassificados Com David Duchovny T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Neste episódio, a ciência torna-se aterradora: testes para criar híbridos homem-macaco, frascos com cheiros de dissidentes e uma ilha soviética dedicada a armas biológicas.

programme.title: Ficheiros Desclassificados Com David Duchovny T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Nesta ocasião, o Espaço revela segredos: planos para explodir a lua, desastres ocultos e espiões em órbita que abriram caminho para a primeira estação espacial secreta.

programme.title: Ficheiros Desclassificados Com David Duchovny T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Neste episódio, gadgets de espionagem surpreendem: brinquedos que salvam vidas, disfarces peludos e balões que deram origem à maior conspiração alienígena da História.

programme.title: Ficheiros Desclassificados Com David Duchovny T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Nesta ocasião, o que acontece quando os governos fazem alianças perigosas: máfias contratadas para assassinatos, tropas aliadas a nazis e assassinos recrutados por líderes em nome de um bem maior.

programme.title: O Inexplicável T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Muitos mistérios da Terra estão longe de resolvidos. Como se formou a Torre do Diabo? Ou porque há gente atingida várias vezes por raios? Se alguns veem nestas ocorrências meras coincidências?.

programme.title: O Inexplicável T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo afirmam ter tido encontros com criaturas não reconhecidas pela Ciência atual, como o Homem Traça, o Chupacabra ou a Larva da Morte da Mongólia.

programme.title: O Inexplicável T3 - Ep. 32
programme.desc: Ao longo da História, todas as grandes civilizações acreditaram em maldições e no seu poder para infligir dano aos incautos. Mas, a serem autênticas, o que as concretiza?.

programme.title: O Inexplicável T3 - Ep. 33
programme.desc: O mundo está repleto de impressionantes exemplos de fenómenos naturais de tal forma espetaculares – e, por vezes, estranhos – que desafiam o senso comum.

programme.desc: A tecnologia LiDAR revela caminhos ocultos da Rota do Âmbar – uma antiga rede comercial que ligava o Mar Báltico ao Mediterrâneo, redefinindo o nosso entendimento da História.

programme.title: Decifrando A História T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Uma descoberta revolucionária em Newgrange revela fortes linhagens dinásticas, desvendando práticas incestuosas entre a elite, que ligam os governantes ancestrais da Irlanda.

programme.title: Os Santos Por Martin Scorsese T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: No Egito do século IV, depois de um momento de fé, Moisés, o Negro, um famigerado salteador, passa por uma transformação radical. Num mosteiro no deserto, renuncia à violência para seguir Cristo.

programme.title: Os Santos Por Martin Scorsese T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Maria Madalena, outrora atormentada, encontra a cura em Jesus de Nazaré. Livre dos seus demónios, torna-se Sua fiel seguidora, testemunhando o Seu ministério, a Sua crucificação e a Sua ressurreição.

programme.title: Impérios Da Antiguidade T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A verdadeira história da enigmática rainha egípcia é a de um génio implacável, que fazia o que fosse necessário para manter o poder perante um Império Romano em franca expansão.

programme.title: Alienígenas: As Origens T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Há indícios que sugerem que a Grande Pirâmide de Gizé pode ter funcionado como central elétrica. Poderão estas estruturas ser a chave para desvendar a verdade sobre o passado da Humanidade?.

programme.title: Alienígenas: As Origens T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Sítios ancestrais, como Stonehenge, Newgrange e as Pirâmides de Gizé, no Egito, revelam fascinantes alinhamentos celestes que parecem longe de ser coincidência. Que propósito teriam?.

programme.title: Decifrando A História T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A tecnologia LiDAR revela caminhos ocultos da Rota do Âmbar – uma antiga rede comercial que ligava o Mar Báltico ao Mediterrâneo, redefinindo o nosso entendimento da História.

programme.title: Decifrando A História T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Uma descoberta revolucionária em Newgrange revela fortes linhagens dinásticas, desvendando práticas incestuosas entre a elite, que ligam os governantes ancestrais da Irlanda.

programme.title: 007 Spectre
programme.desc: Uma mensagem oculta do passado de Bond, coloca-o no rasto de uma organização sinistra. Enquanto M enfrenta uma batalha política para manter os serviços secretos ativos, Bond vai fazer tudo para revelar a terrível verdade que se esconde por trás de SPECTRE.

programme.title: Um Ninja Americano 3
programme.desc: Um homem recém-treinado nas artes marciais deve salvar seu treinador da experimentação.

programme.title: Sede de Viver
programme.desc: Um menino cai sob a tutela não convencional do seu tio, um barman carismático e autodidata.

programme.title: Five Nights at Freddy´s
programme.desc: Um segurança problemático começa a trabalhar na Freddy Fazbear´s Pizza. Durante suas cinco noites de trabalho, ele percebe que algo está errado com a pizzaria e logo descobre a verdade sobre seus animatrônicos.

programme.title: Hollywood News Feed
programme.desc: As novidades, os gossips das suas estrelas favoritas de Hollywood.

programme.title: Detroit
programme.desc: Uma vaga de protestos ocorre em Detroit, no ano de 1967, quando uma operação policial não autorizada provoca a revolta entre a população. Os agentes da autoridade intervêm, mas a justiça da sua forma de atuar é questionável. Baseada em factos reais.

programme.title: Zoom In
programme.desc: Um olhar pelos bastidores dos filmes de maior sucesso de Hollywood.

programme.title: Mulher-Maravilha
programme.desc: Antes de ser a Mulher-Maravilha, era Diana, princesa das Amazonas, treinada para ser uma guerreira invencível. Protegida do exterior, dão-lhe a conhecer o conflito que acontece no mundo e Diana deixa tudo, convencida que pode parar essa ameaça.

programme.title: Meg: Tubarão Gigante
programme.desc: A tripulação de um submergível fica presa no fundo do Oceano depois de ser atacada por uma criatura pré-histórica, um tubarão com mais de 20 metros: o Megalodonte. Caberá a Jonas Taylor resgatá-los, um mergulhador que já se encontrou com a criatura.

programme.title: Blue Beetle
programme.desc: Um escaravelho alienígena escolhe Jaime Reyes para ser seu hospedeiro simbiótico, concedendo ao recém-formado uma armadura capaz de poderes extraordinários, mudando para sempre seu destino ao se tornar o super-herói conhecido como Besouro Azul.

programme.title: Ben-Hur (2016)
programme.desc: A história épica de Judah Ben-Hur, um príncipe falsamente acusado de traição pelo irmão adotivo. Destituído do seu título e separado da família, Judah é submetido à escravidão. Mas quando regressa em busca de vingança, acaba por encontrar a redenção.

programme.title: Harry Potter e os Talismãs da Morte - Part 1
programme.desc: Harry debate-se para fugir às garras de Voldemort, que está cada vez mais forte. Harry vai descobrir a existência dos Talismãs da Morte, artefactos mágicos que podem vir a tornar o seu inimigo ainda mais poderoso.

programme.title: The Revenant: O Renascido
programme.desc: Numa expedição pelo desconhecido território americano, o explorador Hugh Glass é brutalmente atacado por um urso e deixado à morte pelos companheiros. Mas Glass resiste a um sofrimento inimaginável e enfrenta um inverno rigoroso em busca de vingança.

programme.title: On a Wing and a Prayer
programme.desc: Depois que o seu piloto morre inesperadamente no meio do voo, Doug White tem que pousar o avião com segurança e salvar toda a sua família de um perigo intransponível.

programme.title: O Lado Negro
programme.desc: O agente da Interpol Russell Hatch testemunha a morte de um informante quando uma operação aparentemente rotineira dá errado. Anos depois, ele vê se protegendo o filho do informante de um grupo de gangues impiedosas envolvidas numa guerra total.

programme.title: Crank - Veneno no Sangue
programme.desc: Um assassino, envenenado por um rival, terá pouco tempo de vida se não mantiver um elevado nível de adrelina. Manter o stress será a sua salvação.

programme.title: Vingança Letal
programme.desc: Uma mãe, Victoria, está tentando deixar seu passado sombrio como mensageiro de drogas russo para trás, mas o policial aposentado Damon força Victoria a cumprir suas ordens mantendo sua filha como refém.

programme.title: Correio De Alto Risco
programme.desc: Um importante chefe do crime quer matar a única pessoa que pode testemunhar contra ele. Para isso contrata uma misteriosa motoqueira, que sem saber tem como missão de entregar-lhe uma encomenda fatal...

programme.title: A Vingança
programme.desc: John Cutte é dispensado do Exército depois de perder toda a sua equipa numa missão que correu mal, contra o infame traficante ucraniano, Igor Rodin. Mas 3 anos depois, John é procurado pelo seu antigo general para voltar a defrontar Igor...

programme.title: O Primeiro Homem Na Lua
programme.desc: Um relato íntimo sobre a primeira missão tripulada à Lua, contada na perspetiva de Neil Armstrong. Os triunfos e os sacrifícios de Armstrong, da sua família, companheiros e da própria nação, numa das missões mais perigosas da história da Humanidade.

programme.title: Dá e Leva
programme.desc: Um filme baseado na história verídica de um grupo de personal trainers que na década de 90 em Miami, ao perseguir o Sonho Americano acaba envolvido num complicado esquema de extorsão e rapto, que corre terrivelmente mal.

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: A história da parceria revolucionária entre um então desconhecido Michael Jordan e a incipiente divisão de basquete da Nike, que revolucionou o mundo do desporto e da cultura com a marca Air Jordan.

programme.title: Bennett´s War
programme.desc: O soldado Marshall Bennett volta para casa depois de sofrer ferimentos de um dispositivo explosivo improvisado no exterior. Quando ele descobre que seu pai está atrasado em seus pagamentos da hipoteca, Marshall volta- se para uma corrida competitiva para salvar a fazenda da família.

programme.title: Os Sete Magníficos
programme.desc: Um remake do clássico Os Sete Magníficos, onde a população desesperada de Rose Creek contrata a proteção de sete marginais. Enquanto preparam a cidade para um violento confronto, os sete mercenários acabam a lutar por mais do que apenas dinheiro.

programme.title: Harry Potter e Os Talismãs da Morte - Part 2
programme.desc: Harry Potter precisa de se apresentar para fazer o seu último sacrifício, enquanto o confronto final com Lord Voldemort se aproxima. Tudo acaba aqui.

programme.title: The Forbidden kingdom
programme.desc: Uma descoberta feita por um adolescente americano obcecado por kung fu, envia -o numa aventura para a China antiga, onde ele se junta a um bando de guerreiros de artes marciais para libertar o Rei Macaco preso.

programme.title: Meg 2: O Regresso do Tubarão Gigante
programme.desc: Uma equipa de investigação encontra várias ameaças enquanto explora as profundezas do oceano, incluindo uma operação mineira malévola.

programme.title: 13 Horas - Os Soldados Secretos de Benghazi
programme.desc: Uma equipa de operacionais de segurança americanos lutou para expulsar os atacantes e proteger os americanos na embaixada de Benghazi, Líbia. Esta é a história, nunca antes contada, do que verdadeiramente aconteceu durante as 13 horas de ataque.

programme.title: Soldado Universal 4 - Juízo Final
programme.desc: No 4º filme da saga Soldado Universal, John perde a mulher e a filha e só quer vingar-se de Luc Deveraux e Andrew Scott. Terá de enfrentar um exército de soldados geneticamente modificados, enquanto tenta escapar à perseguição sem tréguas da UniSol.

programme.desc: Estas enfermeiras estão disponíveis 24 horas por dia para curar a falta de sexo dos seus pacientes. Se for preciso trabalham aos pares e há uma delas que curas dois ao mesmo tempo, deixando um foder-lhe a rata enquanto o outro lhe espeta a sua seringa no cu!

programme.desc: Filmed at Wembley Arena, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Duran Duran featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Rio', 'Hungry Like The Wolf', 'The Reflex' and many more….

programme.title: Charlie Puth - Live in London 2015

programme.title: Milky Chance - Garorock Festival 2017
programme.desc: The German duet is back and better than ever! Milky Chance is the success story of two school friends, Clemens Rehbein and Philipp Dausch. After a long break, 2017 marks the release of a second, long-waited, album 'Blossom'. And, for the public, finally the occasion to discover live these new compositions, mixing rock, folk and electro pop.

programme.title: The Black Keys - Live at Main Square Festival
programme.desc: Main Square Festival is a music festival that takes place in Arras, France, lasting three days.

programme.title: Justin Timberlake - FutureSex/LoveShow - Live from New York
programme.desc: The FutureSex/LoveSounds album, which spawned the tour FutureSex/LoveShow, is one of the most awarded 2007 albums and has sold more than eight million copies worldwide. 'Sexyback', 'What Comes Around ... Goes Around', 'My Love', 'Summer Love' and 'Lovestoned' are some of the highlights and were among the most played of the year around the world.

programme.title: Florence And The Machine - Austin City Limits
